title: Static Shadows | ECHO//100 Episode 2
description: Kavi follows his runaway shadow into the neon depths of a forgotten arcade. Episode 2 of ECHO//100: The Red Door. This is an AI-assisted original fiction series.

scenes.text: Kavi watches as a shadow detaches from those sneakers and sprints toward the arcade exit.
scenes.caption: Shadow detaches from Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing in a dark arcade, his shadow peeling off the floor like ink, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Byte flickers, scanning the floor where the silhouette once anchored Kavi to the ground.
scenes.caption: Byte scans the floor
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with a cyan face and orange antenna, hovering over the floor tiles, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Arcade walls pulse with static, revealing dozens of silhouettes trapped within the neon glass.
scenes.caption: Trapped ghost silhouettes
scenes.image_prompt: Neon arcade machines displaying 2D shadowy human figures trapped behind the glass screens, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: These shadows are people erased from history, crying out in a cold, binary silence.
scenes.caption: Erased people revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi staring at a screen where a shadow figure presses its hands against the glass, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: The shadow stops before the Red Door, beckoning Kavi to enter the heart of Null.
scenes.caption: Shadow beckons to door
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing red door at the end of a dark corridor, Kavi's independent shadow standing before it, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Mira intercepts Kavi, her holographic coat glowing with a cold, detached, and clinical light.
scenes.caption: Mira reveals truth
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in a blue holographic teal coat holding a data pad, looking at Kavi with a neutral expression, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Mira whispers that the goal is not rescue, but logging a final, permanent deletion.
scenes.caption: Documenting Kavi's deletion
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Mira's face, her eyes reflecting lines of scrolling code, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: The phone screen cracks as a jagged, purple pixelated hand reaches out to grab Kavi.
scenes.caption: Null's hand emerges
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's smartphone screen held by his hand, a dark purple pixelated claw erupting from the glass surface, vertical cinematic shot.
